purpose: 开场漫画斜分割布局静态方案，用于比较全部分镜浮现后的画面

variants.label: 斜向递进
variants.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a polished STATIC layout concept for a game's anime-style diagonally divided comic opening, landscape 16:9, ideally 2560x1440. This is one finished cinematic comic screen, showing all panels after they have appeared. Use the three supplied reference images explicitly: image 1 is the protagonist identity and proportions reference, image 2 is the protagonist material/rendering reference, image 3 is the environment art-direction reference. Generate new narrative compositions based on these references, do not copy their full compositions.
CHARACTER IDENTITY invariant: the same tiny thumb-sized wick spirit throughout, greatly oversized creamy-white flame-shaped head sweeping backwards, two simple dark vertical oval eyes, tiny understated mouth, tiny rounded body, short arms and legs, a small amber flame/leaf-shaped light inset in its chest. Warm ivory paperlike watercolor body with cool gray-blue shadow patches, softly luminous flame tips, very few delicate golden flecks. No clothes, accessories, lamp, umbrella, wings, horns, animal ears, hair, or nose. Small in environmental wide shots, smaller than a broad ivy leaf, roughly comparable in height to a large brick's height; human-scale gates tower vastly overhead. Closeups are camera magnification, not a change in physical size.
ART: sophisticated hand-painted watercolor storybook illustration, fine ink contours and layered handmade paper texture as in the references, muted moss green, slate blue-gray, pale stone, dim amber light. Bring in LIMBO-like silhouetted foreground foliage and atmospheric depth, with the delicate architectural illustration and watercolor quality of Gorogoa. Keep luminous paper, layered color washes, and readable texture; not photorealistic, not 3D plastic, not monochrome, not action manga speedlines. This is a cold dusk before rain, melancholy and quiet with a slight hope of shelter. Heavy cloudy sky, wind-bent leaves, damp ancient stone; rain has NOT started, no rain streaks. Warm glow restricted to the tiny spirit and a faint ambiguous distant glint reflected on greenhouse glass; NO occupied house, person, lit lantern, or visible caretaker. The garden is long abandoned, overgrown ivy, broken pots, inactive tarnished mirror remnants and thick moss. No beams shooting from character hands. No monster, giant creature, glowing scales, extra story characters or later plot reveal.
STORY to communicate in order: walking along abandoned stone wall before rain; noticing a distant intermittent glimmer on greenhouse glass through a gap between plants and briefly hoping for warmth; following that light to a huge old garden gate; slipping through an existing low gap rather than opening a full-sized human gate; discovering the abandoned garden, ending on a moss-covered threshold that can connect into the side-view first level. Story via composition and expressions, no dialogue.
PRESENTATION: rendered artwork fills each panel completely. Intentional clean diagonal/trapezoid anime-comic panel boundaries, thin dark charcoal or slate gutters, no huge white page margins. Clear narrative reading order and exceptionally readable silhouettes. NO text, captions, panel numbers, logos, labels, UI, arrows or watermark anywhere. One single composition, not a sheet of multiple alternative designs.
LAYOUT A: FIVE panels in a cinematic TWO-TIER Z-flow montage. Strong oblique panel cuts, not a rectangular grid or radial pinwheel. TOP tier occupies 43 percent of canvas: panel 1 occupies left 57 percent with a slanting right edge, a distant wide side view of the little spirit walking left to right on the crumbling mossy stone wall beneath giant ivy leaves and storm clouds; panel 2 occupies upper right 43 percent, a tighter three-quarter profile of the spirit pausing behind dark foliage, looking toward a small visible angular glint on the distant greenhouse roof. BOTTOM tier occupies 57 percent, three sequential trapezoids divided by forward-slanting cuts: panel 3 at bottom left 27 percent shows its tiny back approaching the huge twisted ivy-covered gate from outside; panel 4 at bottom middle 23 percent shows a ground-level close shot of it stepping through an already open low gap beneath the gate; panel 5 at bottom right 50 percent is a wider quiet side-view panorama INSIDE, looking across abandoned moss-covered masonry, weeds, a broken pot, empty stone planters, and the distant unlit greenhouse frame. Place the tiny spirit near the left edge of this last panel on the mossy threshold, looking right into the ruin. Diagonals lead the eye down and right; rhythm of wide, close, wide, close, wide. Environment remains intricately watercolored, protagonist is not enlarged to dominate each frame. Top panels and lower panels have a subtly tilted shared dividing gutter. The last panel feels open and spacious.

LAYOUT B: FOUR distinctly asymmetric panels with a dramatic DIAGONAL FOCUS composition. This must look radically different from a row or two-tier comic. Design the two initial scenes as angular upper wedges, a large diagonal portrait panel across the left-middle, and a broad final lower-right reveal. PANEL 1 occupies upper-left approximately 24 percent total canvas: wideshot of tiny spirit traversing a high broken stone wall under overhanging black-green ivy. PANEL 2 is a LARGE TALL diagonal parallelogram left of center, approximately 23 percent canvas, cut by two parallel diagonals: closeup camera shot of the same spirit's head and chest partly framed by ivy, oval eyes turning toward the upper-right with a tentative hopeful expression, soft warm head edges. PANEL 3 occupies the upper-right triangular/trapezoid space approximately 22 percent: POV looking through sharply silhouetted big leaves to distant dilapidated greenhouse glass where one tiny amber glint catches; surrounding panes are mostly gray and dark. PANEL 4 fills the remaining wide bottom-right approximately 31 percent: view through the enormous rusted ajar garden gate into an abandoned garden, tiny spirit just inside on the near-left mossy threshold, moss-covered broken pots and old stone terraces fading toward the same greenhouse. Its newly entered posture and empty overgrown interior communicate finding the gate and realizing abandonment in one shot. Four enclosed clear polygonal panels; no overlap of actual characters across borders. Temporal reading is upper-left walking -> left-center closeup -> upper-right glimmer -> bottom-right garden. This is lyrical mystery, no action lines, no shattered-glass effect, no triangles too small to read. Important: the greenhouse is a distant human-scale structure and appears the same architectural design in both visible views; no humans or literal flame behind glass.

LAYOUT C: FIVE panels in an asymmetric HERO PANORAMA design. FOUR small distinct slanted trapezoid memory panels form a tapering vertical ribbon on the LEFT approximately 34 percent of canvas width. Their top-to-bottom reading is: (1) wide tiny spirit walking the broken wall at dusk; (2) closer spirit peering between giant ivy leaves, distant greenhouse glimmer visible through the gap; (3) tiny spirit arriving below an enormous vine-choked metal garden gate; (4) close low view stepping through the pre-existing gap at the base of the gate. Give each of the four left panels enough height and different focal length, with diagonal boundaries leaning in a consistent direction. Their shared right boundary slopes from x=42 percent at top to x=29 percent at bottom.
The FIFTH and FINAL panel is the uninterrupted grand reveal, occupying ALL remaining approximately 66 percent canvas from near center to the right edge and full canvas height: wide 2D side-on, slightly elevated view into the ABANDONED garden called the mossy threshold. At its near left boundary is the huge ivy-covered gate's stone jamb, and just inside is the minuscule ivory glowing spirit looking into the emptiness. The foreground is a walkable ledge of enormous moss-covered bricks and a broken terra-cotta pot; vines and empty planters trail into the middle ground; distant skeletal greenhouse architecture softened into dusk; layered foliage silhouettes overhead; cold gray-lavender sky beyond. The final panoramic panel must FEEL BIG, STILL AND EMPTY, letting human-scale forgotten architecture dwarf the protagonist. Use strong atmosphere and gentle warm/cold contrast, preserving the fine translucent watercolor details, with inactive old small mirror hardware half-hidden among weeds if visible. The fifth panel is a possible starting composition for gameplay. Clear four small approach panels plus one dominating finale, not five equal columns, not a square grid. No daytime sunlight, no sunbeams, no household lights, no monster.

C: 左列从上到下：行走、见光、到门、穿门
右侧大景：荒废庭园与门槛苔地

validationNotes: 已人工查看三张输出：A为五格双层斜切，B为四格不对称斜切，C为左侧四格与右侧大景。
当前仅为静态布局与美术效果稿；未制作逐格出现动画、闪光节奏、独立分层或游戏接入。
画面内人物比例为概念表现，正式分镜可进一步锁定拇指大小。
